correctness.rationale: Exact fixed-bin allocations yield E(Y_j)_t=(m)_t(n)_{jt}/((j!)^t m^{jt})(1-t/m)^{n-jt}; factorial moments prove independent rare-Poisson limits. Second-moment abundance, vanishing double-small bins, and a matched-bin q-round EF invariant prove the complete all-sentences reduction; finite-definability of capped rare counts proves the converse.
